gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-123.076491 45.221228)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 320 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH park_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-123.076491, 45.221228), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
raster_cells AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(r.rast, 1)).geom AS cell_geom,
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(r.rast, 1)).val AS elevation
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, park_point.geom)
),
filtered_cells AS (
  SELECT cell_geom
  FROM raster_cells
  WHERE elevation < 320
),
nearest_cell AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Distance(park_point.geom::geometry, filtered_cells.cell_geom::geometry) AS distance_meters
  FROM park_point, filtered_cells
  ORDER BY park_point.geom::geometry <-> filtered_cells.cell_geom::geometry
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT distance_meters;
